name: NeonSign
description: Glowing neon lettering on a wall, plus the coloured light it throws into the room — a point light or a spot aimed along the sign's facing. The words are a world-fixed quad, or, with `extruded: true` and the `neonText` Babylon adapter plugin registered (`registerBabylonNeonTextExtension`), real extruded geometry; without the plugin the sign quietly draws the quad. Colour, size, position, rotation, glow and light kind are all live-editable.
